decision.reason: The same upgrade-guide section gives two different new names for the same old metric. [ev-df8818f69d5e] says `doublewrite_identity_crd_only_count` became `doublewrite_crd_only_identities`, but [ev-6a341603b700] says it became `doublewrite_identity_crd_only_total`. The same split appears for the sibling metrics in [ev-eaf366d94d17] vs [ev-7ede52ce8bb8]. Because of this, the proposed consequence statement and remediation, which tell operators to switch to `doublewrite_crd_only_identities`, cannot be confirmed. Settling it needs the metric name actually exposed in v1.17.0, such as the metrics reference or the operator metric definition. A review-level kind (behavior-change) looks plausible, since the evidence says nothing fails.
